buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff.

3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of SrDFM/NR/LKO A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Service & Support In the event where the distance travelled exceeds the monthly usage variant, amount will be paid for additional Kms as per schedule. Similarly, the unused Kms in a particular month as against the minimum guaranteed usage variant will be carried forward to the next month and additional Km if any in the next month shall be adjusted against this. However, the payment for the selected usage variant in a month will be paid every month.” Further, the unused Kms in a particular month shall not be carried forward or adjusted beyond 6 months 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Eligibility criteria-(Vehicle Hiring) Bidder should have successfully completed in the last three financial years and current financial year up to date of opening of Bid, one single service contract of MUV/SUV or higher Car/Taxi hiring for minimum of 3 5% of Bid estimated value. In absence of work experience, the offer will be ignored. Clear and valid work e xperience issued by Government Department, duly mentioning the value of work completed, shall only be admitted as experience certificate under this bid. Purchase order alone shall not be considered as work ex perience. In case of any documents submitted by bidders are found to be forged or fake, the concerned bi dder shall be debarred for future purchases and the action of suspension from the GeM shall also be initiat ed. Or The Service Provider must own 100 % of the bid quantity of Vehicle of same category/segment or higher se gment as required under respective requirement in this bid in Service Provider’s name or in the name of th e proprietor / partner of the Service Provider. RCs as a proof of owner ship to be uploaded by the bidder for verification by the buyer. In absence of RC offer will be ignored. Only Service Provider owned vehicles will be part of the fleet to be deployed by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid. 2. Only Service Provider owned MUV/SUV or higher vehicles will be the part of the fleet to be deployed by t he Service Provider. Consignee shall verify the ownership of the vehicle to be deployed at the start of the s ervice. In case, the service provider fails to supply his owned vehicle against this contract, the GeM contra ct shall be deemed to be defaulted on account of service provider and the concerned service provider shal l be debarred for future purchases and the action of suspension from the GeM shall also be initiated beside s forfeiture of submitted performance guarantee. 3. No additional documents/information, which is not part of original offer shall be accepted after the bid o pening. The offer shall only be evaluated on the basis of details/documents sub mitted in the original offer. 4. Place of work – (a) SSE/TELE/Line-I/LKO (b)SSE/TELE/II/LKO (c) SSE/TELE/BSB

(d)SSE/TELE/AYC (e)SSE/TELE/SLN (f)SSE/TELE/PRG (g)SSE/TELE/RBL 5. The contact details of consignee – OS/S&T/LKO(9794839758). 6. The service provider shall send the vehicle to duty on fully filled tank condition along with all other requ ired compliance. In case of any breach on it, the action against the firm shall be initiated for non-complianc e of the contract terms & conditions. 7. As per administrative requirement, The Railways reserve the right to terminate/Cancel the contract at a ny point of time during currency of contract after giving the notice period of three days without any financi al compensation to the firm. 8. The offers of following bidders shall be summarily ignored – a. Suspended firms on GeM portal. b. The bidders against which the incident of non-delivery of similar products/service has been initiated by this office and is live on the date of bid opening. c. The bidder who has defaulted on GeM contract of similar product/service leading to cancellation of contr act in last one year. 9. In case of any instance of default by the service provider at any point of time during currency of the con tract, the buyer reserves the right to terminate/Cancel the contract immediately with forfeiture of submitte d PBG. 10. In case of any conflict on terms & conditions between ATC and rest of bid, the provision mentioned on ATC shall prevail. 11. It shall be sole responsibility of consignee that vehicle are deployed as per terms and condition of ATC and bid documents. 12. Bidder may note that Consignee Department has no boundation on account of Usage Variant term app earing as 364 hours. Vehicle uses may be 24*7 hours each month. .
